TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: transaction transaction to obtain a price rule by your id
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains pricingRuleId through getPricingruleid() and logs the value before invoking the library. If pricingRuleId != null && pricingRuleId < 0, it adds advice ABKO00000050 and sets Severity.WARN. 2. Decisions and branches: the negative pricingRuleId branch only raises a warning and execution continues. After the library call, if priceRule == null, the transaction logs the condition, adds advice ABKO00000040, and sets Severity.WARN. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() obtains ABKOR000 through getServiceLibrary(ABKOR000.class) and calls executeGetPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId). The implementation adds pricingRuleId to the JDBC query parameters, executes GET_PRICING_RULE_BY_ID_QUERY, returns null when no row is found, and otherwise maps the first returned row to PricingRuleGetDTO, including fee, effectiveDate, related entities, paymentMethods, and customAttributes. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: ABKO00000050 is emitted when pricingRuleId is negative and is reported with 04 - WARNING. ABKO00000040 is emitted when executeGetPricingRuleById returns null and is reported with 04 - WARNING. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: after logging the returned value, setPricingrule(priceRule) is always executed with the PricingRuleGetDTO returned by the library or with null when no row is found.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieve a pricing rule by its identifier by adding pricingRuleId to the query parameters, executing GET_PRICING_RULE_BY_ID_QUERY, and mapping the first returned row to PricingRuleGetDTO.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.
